question: In August 2024, Biochemist Govindarajan Padmanabhan was awarded which of the following awards?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vigyan Ratna Puraskar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Govindarajan Padmanabhan, a renowned biochemist, was awarded the **Vigyan Ratna Puraskar** in August 2024.
 
• The Vigyan Ratna Puraskar is one of India's highest honors given for significant contributions in the field of science and technology.
 
• It recognizes individuals who have made outstanding achievements and advancements in scientific research.
 
• The award includes a certificate, a medal, and a cash prize, acknowledging the recipient's dedication and impact on science.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award:**

 
 
• Named after Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar, the founder director of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR).
 
• Awarded annually for notable and outstanding research in various fields of science and technology.
 
• Considered one of the most prestigious science awards in India.
 
 
 
• **Vigyan Yuva-Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar:**
 
 
• Awarded to young scientists for their remarkable contributions to scientific research.
 
• Recognizes the potential of young researchers to become leaders in their respective scientific fields.
 
• Aims to encourage and motivate young talent in science and technology.
 
 
 
• **Vigyan Shri:**
 
 
• Awarded to individuals for significant contributions to the popularization and promotion of science and technology.
 
• Acknowledges efforts in making science accessible and engaging to the general public.
 
• Highlights the importance of science communication in society.
